walkthrough-self.title: change fabric in 44 seconds
walkthrough-self.alt: change fabric in 44 seconds: a narrated walkthrough of the toolkit gating a pull request
walkthrough-self.transcript: Your agents write code faster than anyone can review it. Change fabric checks every change before it lands. One CHANGE.md per repo: what to test, what is protected. Every enabled lane runs: load, accessibility, security, responsive UX, and test cases. Findings land in one report. The gate records the result for the head commit, and only a pass lets the merge or release tag through. Ship agent-written code with proof, not hope. Change fabric.
